prompts.text:
Replace the character in the video with the person from the uploaded image. Keep actions, poses, facial expressions, camera movement and rhythm. Preserve the person's original facial features, maintain character consistency, no distortion, no glitches, no artifacts.
The person dances in the place from the uploaded image, in the clothes and shoes from the uploaded image, not the black track jacket with white stripes and the black wide trousers of the young man in the video, and keeps their own hair from the uploaded image, not the man's black hair. Follow the man's moves and timing exactly: he stands relaxed with the hands at the waist, steps into a wide stance and leans the whole body to one side with the hands at the chest, then pops the chest forward hard on the beat, twice; he hits one arm out to the side, rolls the body with a hand up near the face, lifts one knee with the arms open, throws one arm over the head, drops into a wide stance with both arms bent up beside the head, opens both arms wide to the sides, lifts a knee again with the hands in front, brings one hand up to the face with a step, and ends in a low wide stance with the arms out and a cool look into the camera. Keep the whole body in view from head to feet, with natural balance and stable ground contact. Exactly one person, no other people. One continuous shot. No costume, no stripes on the clothes unless the uploaded image shows them, no text, no captions, no logos.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same bright bedroom with tall dark-framed glass doors and white curtains behind, the same bed with a blue and white patchwork quilt, the same phone camera in front of the bed that drifts a little, the same framing, timing and moves, one continuous take with no cuts. The ONLY change: the dog in the yellow vest who stands on its hind legs on the bed and dances is now the pet in [Image 1].

The dancer = the pet in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: the same species and breed, head shape, muzzle, eyes, ears, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything, so its owner instantly recognizes it from the first second to the last. Never drift back to the dog of the original video: not the coat, not the face and not the ears of the dog in the video, unless [Image 1] shows them. Only the pet changes: it keeps the little yellow sleeveless vest with the black trim. If [Image 1] shows a cat or another animal, that animal stands upright on its hind legs on the same bed and dances the same moves, with its own face, ears, whiskers and tail.

The dance, beat by beat, exactly as in [Video 1]:
0-1 s: close to the camera, standing on its hind legs, looking into the lens.
1-2 s: it steps back and punches one front paw out to the side.
2-3.5 s: a wide stance, one front paw swings high over the head, the other out wide.
3.5-5 s: it crouches low with the front paws crossed in front of the chest and bounces.
5-6.5 s: it turns to the side, leans the body and pops the chest forward, then turns back to the camera.
6.5-8 s: both front paws swing out to the side, then one paw comes up to the face.
8-10 s: the front paws come together in front of the chest, a small bounce, and a last pose with a paw near the face.

Real live-action footage, one continuous take, a clear and stable face, real animal anatomy, the same pet in every frame, the same fur.

Anatomy rules: one head only. Two hind legs and two front legs, furry paws covered in the pet's own fur, never human hands or fingers, no extra legs or paws. Exactly one animal, no people. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
